newsitem.title: USA: Man holds hostage in suburban Chicago mall.
newsitem.headline: Man holds hostage in suburban Chicago mall.

text.p: A man held his former girlfriend at gunpoint on Friday after firing shots inside the beauty salon where she worked at a suburban Chicago shopping mall, police said.

Police said they were talking by telephone with the unidentified man, whom they had arrested twice previously for battery against the woman. They did not believe anyone was hurt in the incident at the Mario Tricochi Hair Salon & Spa.

"We have not walked into the salon but we have phone contact," Skokie Police spokesman Robert Mason said. The man was secluded in a back room of the salon, located in the crowded Old Orchard Shopping Centre in this north Chicago suburb, he said.
Friends of the woman said the two had dated earlier in the year, and the man became possessive and violent after she broke off the relationship over the summer.
A witness who was inside the salon told WBBM-Radio the man pulled a gun and angrily ordered patrons out of the salon after talking with the woman.

"I think he fired at the ceiling," she said. "We all were running, and people were out in the mall wondering what was going on, and we told them, 'There's a man with a gun.' Then we went into a store and there were two other girls who worked at Mario Tricochi who said it was her ex-boyfriend and she had a restraining order."
Police escorted panicked patrons away from the salon and cordoned off the north end of the outdoor shopping centre. Elsewhere in the huge mall, customers continued shopping.
Witnesses reported seeing patrons fleeing the salon shortly before 2 p.m. CST (3 p.m. EST), then police arrived with guns drawn and ordered shoppers and shopkeepers to evacuate.
